paragraphs.text: Sephara , Sky's Blade , is an angel from an unknown plane originally introduced in Core Set 2020 .

Sephara is an angel in golden armor, a skirt, and brown feathered wings. She can mentally or magically control at least 4 swords around her at a given time likely leading to her epitaph. She has long brown hair with jewels wrapped around her head. She is known for such quotes as "As long as your courage remains, your life will not falter." when reviving people and "It is not punishment. I am simply making things as they should be." when destroying them.
